themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, explore data, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including analysis of their effectiveness and security.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing platforms, frameworks, and tools specifically built to facilitate or automate various stages of research.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to research, inform, and assist in the design process, including UI/UX prototyping and concept generation.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI applications that assist product managers in tasks like strategy, roadmap planning, and feature development.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI's application in analyzing customer feedback, reviews, and social media to gauge sentiment and identify key themes.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in automating, enhancing, or analyzing usability testing processes and results.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles examining the effects of AI on employment, job roles, recruitment, and the skills needed in the modern workforce.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on research into the behavior, impact, and limitations of AI chatbots, particularly in user interactions and information seeking.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
